bio_md:
# 南平武信王 · 主要事迹

高季兴，陕州硖石人，本为汴州富人李让之仆，后事朱温，以军功起家。开平元年（907），后梁以季兴为荆南节度使，镇江陵——荆南（南平）国之始。同光二年（924），后唐封季兴为南平王。

南平据江陵弹丸之地，「地狭兵寡」，为十国中最弱者；季兴以「事大」为生：梁、唐、晋、汉、周五代更迭，季兴父子「随所胜者而臣之」，又拦截诸国商贾，「诸国商贾过境，无不抽税」，史称「高赖子」——十国之讥，莫此为甚。

天成三年（928），季兴卒。南平虽弱小无足道，然其「赖事大以存」，历高氏五主四十余年，至 963 年为宋所灭——「高赖子」之讥虽刻，然「苟全性命于乱世」，亦有其生存之道。

> 参考：点校本《新五代史》卷069《南平世家》。

bio_parts_en.value:
Gao Jixing, a man of Xiashi in Shanzhou, began as a servant of a rich man of Bianzhou, then served Zhu Wen and rose by merit. In the 1st year of Kaiping (907) Later Liang made him military governor of Jingnan, holding Jiangling — the beginning of Jingnan (Nanping). In the 2nd year of Tongguang (924) Later Tang made him King of Nanping.

Nanping held the sliver of Jiangling, "the land narrow and the soldiers few," the weakest of the Ten Kingdoms; Jixing lived by "serving the great": through Liang, Tang, Jin, Han, and Zhou he and his sons "served whichever won," and they stopped the merchants of every state, "taxing all the merchants who passed" — the histories call him the "Gao rascal," the mockery of the age at its sharpest.

He died in the 3rd year of Tiancheng (928). Small and contemptible as Nanping was, "it lived by serving the great," through five Gao rulers and over forty years, until Song destroyed it in 963 — the "Gao rascal" mocked, yet "keeping whole one's life amid the storm" had its own way.

> References: the punctuated critical edition of the *Xin Wudaishi*, ch. 69 ("Annals of Nanping").
